## addlink SSD Compatible with PS5 Models

• AddGame A90, A92, and A95 SSD. (Default with premium heatsink, recommend) 
• addlink S90, S92, and S95 SSD. 

## Troubleshooting tips

If your PS5 does not detect or recognize you SSD, please check these things first.

1. Check your SSD SPEC, if Your SSD is M.2 NVMe Gen4x4 SSD. 2. Please make sure you fully plugged it hard to the expansion connector

3. Please check if your PS5 with the latest firmware

• Please make sure your software have been updated to the latest version (system software version 21.02-04 or higher). 

You can go to Settings > System > System Software > System Software Update and Settings > Update System Software.

...

4. If the PS5 still can't be recognized. please follow the below step to format on PC and go back to format in PS5 again.

• Insert your SSD to the Desktop PC M.2 NVMe slot 
• Right-click on Start, the Windows icon on the bottom left side of the screen, and Click [Disk Management]

Product Introduction

addlink M.2 PCIe SSD Toolbox is a software that allows you to view current drive

Important Notice

- Please backup your data before executing “secure erase” - The Toolbox is for us with addlink X70, S72, S90, S92, S95, A90, A92, and A95 SSD

Title: addlink Consumer Products Warranty Policy
URL: https://www.addlink.com.tw/_files/ugd/ef4c6b_f3bf0b79e2dc4315b1926d01d1660e2f.pdf
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
### Limited Warranty Condition

The limited warranty period for Solid State Storage ends when either of the 
following occurs: 
(a) the time limit specified by the warranty expires, or (b) the Solid-State Storage 
reaches its endurance limit (TBW – Total Bytes Written). TBW is a measure of the 
SSD's expected lifespan. The SSD SMART percentage used value, as indicated by 
CrystalDiskInfo or addlink's toolbox, reflects the TBW status. 
Reference tools: 
• CrystalDiskInfo: https://crystalmark.info/en/software/crystaldiskinfo/ 
• addlink SSD Toolbox: https://www.addlink.com.tw/ssdtoolbox Checking SSD Remaining Lifespan Using either CrystalDiskInfo or the addlink Toolbox, locate the Percentage Used value (SMART attribute ID 05): 
• Percentage Used = 0: New, unused product — full TBW lifespan remaining. 
• Percentage Used ≥ 100: Drive has reached or exceeded its TBW endurance limit. Warranty coverage for endurance-related failures ends at this point. 

#### Duration of Warranty

The duration of the warranty for Solid State Storage is limited and ends at the earlier of two conditions: either the time limit specified by warranty expires, or the product reaches its endurance limit.
